nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A$ and $B$ be square matrices over $R$ indexed by a finite type $n$. Regard $B + XA$ as a matrix over the polynomial ring $R[X]$. Then the coefficient of $X$ in the polynomial $\det(B + XA)$ equals the first-order term of the determinant $L_B(A) = \sum_{i \in n} \det B^{(i)}$, where $B^{(i)}$ is the matrix $B$ with its $i$-th row replaced by the $i$-th row of $A$.
nodes.title: The coefficient of $X$ in $\det(B + XA)$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, let $B$ be a square matrix over $K$ indexed by a finite type $n$, and let $u, v \in K^n$. Then for every $t \in K$, $\det(B + t\,uv^{\mathsf T}) = \det B + t\,(\det(B + uv^{\mathsf T}) - \det B)$.
nodes.title: The determinant is affine along a rank-one direction

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A$, $B$, $C$ be square matrices over $R$ indexed by a finite type $n$. Write $L_B(A) = \sum_{i \in n} \det B^{(i)}_A$, where $B^{(i)}_A$ is the matrix $B$ with its $i$-th row replaced by the $i$-th row of $A$. Then $L_B(A + C) = L_B(A) + L_B(C)$.
nodes.title: Additivity of the first-order term of the determinant

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $a \in R$, and let $A$ and $B$ be square matrices over $R$ indexed by a finite type $n$. Write $L_B(A) = \sum_{i \in n} \det B^{(i)}_A$, where $B^{(i)}_A$ is the matrix $B$ with its $i$-th row replaced by the $i$-th row of $A$. Then $L_B(aA) = a \, L_B(A)$.
nodes.title: Homogeneity of the first-order term of the determinant

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A$ and $B$ be square matrices over $R$ indexed by a finite type $n$. The first-order term of the determinant of $B$ in the direction $A$ is $L_B(A) = \sum_{i \in n} \det B^{(i)}$, where $B^{(i)}$ is the matrix $B$ with its $i$-th row replaced by the $i$-th row of $A$.
nodes.title: First-order term of the determinant

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
